findings.evidence: Intent says implicit FK cascades should still modify non-Public tables: `pkg/ddl/create_table.go:214-216`. But planner now hard-rejects any non-Public table: `pkg/planner/core/preprocess.go:1848-1856` (returns `ErrTableNotExists` when `retTbl.Meta().State != StatePublic`). FK cascades are executed by generating internal DELETE/UPDATE and running `Preprocess` + `OptimizeForForeignKeyCascade`: `pkg/executor/foreign_key.go:787-791`, which builds plans via `PlanBuilder.buildDataSource` that always calls `tryLockMDLAndUpdateSchemaIfNecessary`: `pkg/planner/core/logical_plan_builder.go:4375`. Also, CREATE TABLE sets FK state public up-front (`pkg/ddl/create_table.go:90-91`), so CASCADE/SET NULL paths are chosen even while table state is `DeleteOnly` (`pkg/ddl/create_table.go:208-213`).
findings.fix: Either (a) explicitly allow internal FK-cascade planning/execution to access non-Public tables (e.g., gate the non-Public-table rejection in `tryLockMDLAndUpdateSchemaIfNecessary` on a dedicated internal-cascade flag such as `StmtCtx.InHandleForeignKeyTrigger`/context key), or (b) make FK trigger building treat `childTable.Meta().State != StatePublic` as non-cascade (e.g., downgrade to restrict-style FK check) to avoid planning a child-table DML that will be rejected.
findings.impact: ON DELETE/UPDATE CASCADE (and SET NULL) can’t be applied when the child table is in `WriteOnly/DeleteOnly` (e.g., during DROP TABLE/CREATE TABLE(FK)/restore windows). The implicit cascade executor will fail at plan build with `ErrTableNotExists`, causing the outer DML to error/rollback and contradicting the stated/encoded behavior that implicit cascades should still modify the table.
findings.later_fix_evidence: Checked `upstream/master`: `pkg/planner/core/preprocess.go` still rejects non-Public tables in `tryLockMDLAndUpdateSchemaIfNecessary`, and `pkg/executor/foreign_key.go` still builds cascade plans via `Preprocess` + `OptimizeForForeignKeyCascade` (no visible bypass for FK triggers).
findings.verify: Add a failpoint-based test that pauses at child-table `WriteOnly/DeleteOnly` (e.g., during `DROP TABLE child`), then runs a parent-table DELETE/UPDATE that should cascade into the child and asserts it succeeds (and that explicit DML on the non-Public child still yields `Table doesn't exist`). Also cover the CREATE TABLE(FK) intermediate state similarly to ensure implicit cascades don’t fail with `ErrTableNotExists`.
findings.what: Implicit foreign-key cascade DML is likely broken by the new “non-Public table => ErrTableNotExists” planner gate: the PR/comment states cascades should still modify `WriteOnly/DeleteOnly` tables, but FK cascades are executed via internal SQL planning that now rejects those tables.

subject: ddl, planner: avoid running queries on the non-Public state table (#55891)
summary: This commit makes `WriteOnly/DeleteOnly` tables invisible to planner execution by returning `ErrTableNotExists`, changes CREATE TABLE(with FK) to use `DeleteOnly` as the intermediate state, and keeps dropped tables in infoschema until `StateNone` for FK-related metadata behavior; tests/mocks are updated accordingly.
